title: Tamsin and the Contact
author: E. M. Quintana
blurb: Marguerite Eriksen, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
